2025-06-26 templates / empty-states / collections
e04f498

Unless understands empty collections

Fez added a practical empty-state block whose truthiness rules match the way interface data is actually shaped.

<script>
  class {
    init() {
      this.state.notifications = []
    }

    add() {
      this.state.notifications.push({
        id: Date.now(),
        text: 'Build completed',
      })
    }
  }
</script>

<button onclick="fez.add()">Add notification</button>

{#unless state.notifications}
  <p>You are all caught up.</p>
{/unless}

{#each state.notifications as notification}
  <p key={notification.id}>{notification.text}</p>
{/each}
